saw_lines: People buy a phone with a plan attached, and they compare the monthly cost before anything else.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a buyer decides if the price matters to them.
Your 2 live ads show no proof number, so new buyers have nothing to trust yet. Lead the next creative with one review count or orders shipped and make it visible.
